motion.$description: Motions by what moves. Where a motion has a spring (`dev.westron.spring`, duration and bounce), platforms with springs use it; the others use its curve and duration. Under Reduce Motion a spring loses its bounce and travel becomes a fade of at most 150 ms (decisions/0013).

fade.$description: A change of color or opacity: a hover tint, a selection, a fade in or out. It has no spring and no bounce.

press.$description: A control answering a press: its tint, and its scale down to 98 %.

toggle.$description: A small thing changing place: a switch's thumb, a segmented control's selection, a checkbox.

check.$description: A check popping into a done task. The one motion with a visible overshoot.

move.$description: Something moving to a new place: a reordered row, a dropped item, a section folding or unfolding.

enter.$description: Something appearing: a popover, a menu, an inserted row.

leave.$description: Something leaving: a deleted row, a closing popover. Leaving is quicker than entering and does not bounce.

reveal.$description: A large surface appearing: a sheet, a side panel, an opened card.
